title: Big Days
cn: 第 1 集 · 重大日子
novel: It was a big day at MacLaren's bar. Ted and Barney [[argued|argue]] over who had [[dibs|dibs]] on a pretty girl sitting by the window. Barney [[claimed|claim]] he saw her first, but Ted [[insisted|insist]] that he had already [[approached|approach]] her with a smile. The two friends [[nearly|nearly]] came to blows before they realized the girl had already left. Meanwhile, Cindy returned to the bar. She was Ted's ex-girlfriend and also the [[roommate|roommate]] of Ted's future wife. Ted did not know this yet, of course. He felt [[awkward|awkward]] seeing her again, but they exchanged a [[polite|polite]] greeting. Robin sat in the corner, looking [[miserable|miserable]]. She was [[heartbroken|heartbroken]] over Don, who had left her for a job in Chicago. Her friends tried to [[comfort|comfort]] her, but she [[refused|refuse]] to talk about her feelings. She simply [[stared|stare]] at her drink and sighed. Marshall, on the other hand, was full of [[enthusiasm|enthusiasm]]. He [[announced|announce]] to the group that he and Lily wanted to start a family. Lily [[blushed|blush]] but nodded in agreement. They had been [[discussing|discuss]] the idea for weeks and finally felt [[ready|ready]]. Ted smiled at his friends and realized that even though his own love life was [[complicated|complicate]], the people around him were moving forward. It was indeed a day of big moments and even bigger [[decisions|decision]].

argue.en: to disagree with someone in words

dibs.en: a claim on something before others

claim.en: to say that something is true

approach.en: to move closer to someone or something

roommate.en: a person who shares a room or apartment

heartbroken.en: feeling extremely sad because of love

comfort.en: to make someone feel less sad

stare.en: to look at something for a long time

enthusiasm.en: a strong feeling of excitement and interest

announce.en: to tell people about something publicly

blush.en: to become red in the face from emotion

discuss.en: to talk about something with someone

ready.en: prepared and willing to do something

complicate.en: to make something more difficult to deal with

decision.en: a choice that you make about something
